description: Solo team from Campinas, working on the challenge Harmonization of MODIS and VIIRS Hot Spots. Our project, Brasa, calibrates 25 years of NASA FIRMS fire hotspots into one consistent monthly record for Brazil, its 6 biomes and 27 states, and publishes it as an open web calendar with an early-warning view for fire brigades and civil defense. Skills: data analysis, statistics, Python, TypeScript and data visualization. The team is complete.
